items.text: Design and development of network control and telemetry systems
Real-time processing of network performance data (KPI monitoring)
Development of C/C++ based system software on Linux
Development of control applications (xApps or similar network applications)
Strong C/C++ programming in Linux environment
Familiar with multi-threading, concurrency, performance optimization
Experience with debugging tools (gdb, strace, perf)
Understanding of 5G RAN architecture and O-RAN concepts
Experience in ML/RL for networking optimization

description.text:
AI Data Center 是本事業群重要發展方向，因應 AI／GPU 算力快速成長，聚焦高速網路、電力、液冷散熱、800VDC、儲能及智慧能源管理等關鍵技術。加入我們，參與 AI Data Center 從電力、散熱、網路到能源管理的整合開發，與我們一起打造新世代 AI 基礎設施！
We are looking for a Network Systems Software Engineer to develop high-performance, real-time software systems for next-generation mobile and wireless network platforms.
The role involves working on distributed network control systems (including 5G RAN related components), real-time telemetry processing, and software-defined network optimization platforms.
You will work on:
• Design and development of network control and telemetry systems
• Real-time processing of network performance data (KPI monitoring)
• Development of C/C++ based system software on Linux
• Development of control applications (xApps or similar network applications)
Required Skills
• Strong C/C++ programming in Linux environment
• Experience in system-level software development
• Familiar with multi-threading, concurrency, performance optimization
• Experience with debugging tools (gdb, strace, perf)
Nice to Have
• Experience with O-RAN E2AP / E2SM
• Understanding of 5G RAN architecture and O-RAN concepts
• Experience in ML/RL for networking optimization
• Docker / large-scale system deployment experience
